messages:
maya: Heads-up: since ~02:10 UTC some edge GPU nodes in ap-southeast-1 are getting NXDOMAIN for internal-service.svc.cluster.local intermittently. Inference pods start returning 5xx when they hit the backend.

jon: Any chance it's ndots / search ordering? can you paste /etc/resolv.conf from a failing pod or the node?

maya: pasted from one failing host:
```
/etc/resolv.conf
nameserver 10.100.0.10
search svc.cluster.local cluster.local
options ndots:5 timeout:1 attempts:2 rotate
```

sam: Those nodes are running node-local-dns (DaemonSet) which forwards to 10.100.0.10. Worth checking node-local-dns logs for cache evictions / upstream errors.

infra-bot: node-local-dns metrics (last 15m): cache_evicted=124, upstream_timeout=47, servfail_rate=0.12. dashboard: https://grafana.internal/d/cluster/dns (link)

jon: I ran `dig internal-service.svc.cluster.local @10.100.0.10 +trace` from the host. Results flip between the IP and SERVFAIL. When SERVFAIL happens the negative answer seems to be cached briefly (ttl ~30s).

elaine: FWIW we also saw NAT gateway conntrack at ~65530/65536 on the same AZ. UDP retries for DNS were getting dropped -> lots of retry behavior.

maya: Quick mitigation: restarted node-local-dns on 3 nodes -> immediate recovery for those nodes. But the problem surfaced on other nodes ~10m later. Feels like a combination: upstream split-horizon inconsistencies + node-local cache evictions + UDP drops on egress.

jon: Also found some hosts where /run/systemd/resolve/resolv.conf -> 127.0.0.53 (systemd-resolved) and the stub was forwarding to a public resolver due to a bad egress route for that host. So some queries left the cluster and got different answers.

sam: Proposed action items:
- bump conntrack on NAT gateways (65536 -> 262144) to reduce UDP drops
- enable DNS over TCP fallback or use TCP upstreams for node-local-dns to avoid UDP fragility
- reduce ndots from 5 -> 2 for typical pod DNS patterns to limit extra lookups to upstream split-horizon views
- audit internal zone SOA/negative-TTL to avoid harmful negative caching behavior

ops-oncall: I'm opening a ticket and tagging networking + sre. Will schedule a controlled daemonset rollout of node-local-dns and coord with infra to bump conntrack. If this persists >30m, we escalate to a full incident and do a postmortem.

maya: Thanks — I'll attach `dig +trace` logs and node-local-dns logs to the ticket. tagging @networking @sre. :+1:

jon: quick note: if you need to reproduce, run a loop of dig from multiple nodes at once to surface split-horizon divergence.

sam: on it, will also test TCP upstream and report back. :mag:

elaine: added a short runbook step in the ticket for rolling restart and conntrack bump so oncall can follow without deep infra changes.

ops-oncall: acknowledged. monitoring alert suppressed for the next 45m while we remediate.
